summary: Solo climber Bob Dergay fell ~100 feet to his death free-soloing Bastille Crack in Eldorado Canyon State Park; witnesses saw him climbing alone without ropes or a harness Saturday evening; 911 was called ~7:49 p.m.
location: Bastille Crack, Eldorado Canyon State Park
notes: Date pinned via the May-18-2019-dated MountainProject thread and dailycamera.com/2019/05/18/ story URL; May 18, 2019 was a Saturday, matching the 'Saturday evening' 911-call detail. kool1079 page subagent-opened this run.
